item.title: co-creating live a/v at Seeds Residency 2025
item.description:
Workshop description + requirements:
#

My workshop explored our presence and perception of reality at the residency/farm through audiovisual media. Drawing from my practise of continuous consumption and actively processing said consumption through video, we investigated how our surroundings shaped our identities and creative expressions. Actively learning from and engaging in the regenerative practises of the farm, this workshop provided the space and time for the residents to create together. During this workshop, we collected audiovisual information from our immediate surroundings while composing a live a/v set together. What happens when we bring insert play and collaboration into our individual creative practises?

item.title: everyone can create live visuals
item.description:
I was invited by Dominika Goralska to give a workshop at the Ateliér of Koncept - objekt - instalace at the University of Ostrava. This was organised around the same time as my solo exhibition at Galerie Provoz, which was curated by Dominika ⋆˙⟡♡

Workshop description + requirements:
#

You are invited to join this workshop on creating live visuals that will focus on the accessibility of tools and the intention of storytelling. Followed by a presentation on my work and practise with live visuals, we will work together to make small experiments. So, bring yourselves, any found footage along with your phones and laptops (if possible).

item.title: collaborative video workshop at Insomnia Festival 2021
item.description:
Workshop description + requirements:
#

Everything I make is in an attempt to position myself in the world. I pose questions that I answer through video.

During the course of these two hours, I will briefly share how I make this happen with a combination of content, feelings, techniques, media and people. We will then work together for the rest of the workshop. Participants are strongly(!) encouraged to contribute their skills and thoughts to the process. Each of us will play a key role in the creation of a collaborative work(s).
